text:
Jordan M: @channel Heads-up: we're deprecating the A100x preemptible dedicated pools. This affects preemptible/reserved-a100x clusters only. Timeline: 60-day notice, final cutoff 2025-08-15. Please read, plan migrations, and flag blockers ASAP. :warning:
Priya K: quick q — why now?
Jordan M: Priya K: two reasons: (1) utilization has been low and fragmentation hurts latency guarantees; (2) A100x fleet is being phased for newer H200/A10G pools we can scale more predictably.
Samir G: Ops note: will there be an automatic fallback for running jobs when the pool hits cutoff?
Jordan M: Samir G: yes — after cutoff we will redirect compatible jobs to H200 reserved or A10G reserved pools. We won't silently change GPU type for pinned workloads; customers with model-pin must opt into migration.
Emily R: Migration options listed in the plan doc: 1) auto-migrate (best-effort, may change quantization profile) 2) manual rerun on target pools 3) request dedicated migration assistance from Solutions. Link: <https://go.redwood.ai/internal/dedicated/a100x-deprecation>
SRE-Oncall: Need runbooks updated — will create a follow-up todo. Also, what's the expected burst capacity during migration?
Jordan M: SRE-Oncall: estimated burst demand ~15% of baseline for first 2 weeks in each region; we have reserved burst windows scheduled. We'll publish per-region capacity charts by tomorrow.
CostOps: Note on billing: preemptible discounts will be removed at cutoff; any committed credits for A100x will be prorated and applied to replacement pools. Customers on Reserved contracts will be contacted individually to adjust SKUs.
Alex T: Is there a quick CLI for operators to list affected customers and their pinned models?
Samir G: here's a snippet I used to find pinned models in eu-west-1:
```
redwoodctl query-instances --filter "gpu_type=a100x-preemptible" --fields customer_id,pinned_model,created_at
```
Samir G: will share a fuller script in #eng-infra later.
Priya K: Any alerting changes we should look for?
Jordan M: Priya K: yes — new alert `dedicated.a100x.deprecation.warning` will fire starting 30d before cutoff. Also `dedicated.migration.failures` if auto-migration errors exceed threshold. OpsBot will post periodic summaries.
OpsBot: [automated] Scheduled reminder created: 30d/14d/7d/1d before cutoff.
Emily R: Customer comms plan: sending 2 emails next week (early notice + migration checklist). Also adding a console banner with migration button and one-click trial on target pools.
SRE-Oncall: I'll draft the rollback playbook. Can we get a list of workloads that cannot tolerate GPU changes (low-level fp requirements)?
Jordan M: Good call. Send notes to product@redwood.ai and we will triage.
CostOps: FYI — cost delta estimates for standard RLHF workloads: A100x -> H200 ~ +8% token cost, while A100x -> A10G ~ -3% depending on batch size. We'll publish per-model guidance.
Alex T: tagging @Eng-Infra so tooling can prepare migration scripts and quota checks.
Jordan M: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Eng-Infra: publish migration scripts and runbooks (due in 3 business days). (2) SRE: update alerts + playbooks. (3) Support/Product: queue customer emails and console banner. (4) CostOps: publish cost deltas and recommended target pool mappings. We'll run a dry-run migration next Wednesday in staging — invite to follow. :rocket:
